content:
leo-release: Heads up: planning a staged rollout tonight at 02:15 UTC for api v2.0.0, runtime v2.12.3, router v3.5.0. Console needs a tiny proxy change to attach X-Canary header for routing.
maya-runtime: Runtime change is a new KV-prefetch path + opt-in batching. Default batching OFF. Prefetch behind `prefetch_v2` flag.
rafael-router: Router introduces sticky-session header handling (accepts X-Sticky-Session). We'll fallback to old behavior if header missing. Can console set both X-Canary and X-Sticky-Session for canary traffic?
jen-console: Yep, console proxy PR coming. Itarget a hotfix branch so it can be rolled back independently. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4301 (preview: green).
owen-eng: Let's pin at start. Suggest pins: api@v2.0.0 runtime@v2.12.3 router@3.5.0 for the 10% and 30% waves, unpin before 100% unless signoffs. Rollback plan: if 5xx > 0.4% for 5m OR regen p95 > +20% => rollback runtime only. Also thermostat: if cpu throttle > 90% we auto-hold.
deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy: 02:15 UTC. Waves: 5% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. Pin command queued. Canary observers: maya-runtime, rafael-router, jen-console.
leo-release: Please pin before first wave: `/deploy pin api@v2.0.0 runtime@v2.12.3 router@3.5.0 --note "staged pin for 02:15 canary"`
deploy-bot: Command received: `/deploy pin api@v2.0.0 runtime@v2.12.3 router@3.5.0` Waiting confirmations.
maya-runtime: :thumbsup:
rafael-router: :thumbsup:
jen-console: :thumbsup:
owen-eng: Quick telemetry addition: enable a short-lived synthetic job hitting regen path at 500ms intervals to exercise prefetch. Add to canary monitors.
leo-release: Added synthetic to monitoring runbook. Linking runbook: https://go/runbooks/staged-prefetch-2026 (internal)
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (5%) started at 02:15:12 UTC. Monitors active: latency, 5xx, sticky-session misses, cpu throttle, mem pressure.
maya-runtime: Wave 1 looks clean. Prefetch logs show cold misses ~ expected. Batching OFF.
rafael-router: Sticky-session header present on canary traffic. No increase in connection failures.
jen-console: Console proxy logs show headers appended. No schema warnings.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (30%) initiated at 02:23:50 UTC.
maya-runtime: At 30% we see regen p95 +9% baseline, CPU 58%. No 5xx spike.
owen-eng: Good. Hold 10m then proceed to 60%.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (60%) started at 02:34:10 UTC.
maya-runtime: p95 is trending to +18% vs baseline, p50 +7%. 5xx still under 0.2%.
leo-release: If p95 crosses +20% or 5xx >0.4% for sustained 5m we trigger runtime rollback. Be ready.
rafael-router: Observed a small uptick in sticky-session misses (~0.7%) after 60% but below our 1.5% concern threshold.
jen-console: PR ready to revert header changes if needed.
deploy-bot: No rollback triggered. Wave 4 (100%) kicked at 02:45:00 UTC.
maya-runtime: After 100% p95 settled at +15%, regen errors minimal. KV pressure steady.
owen-eng: Closing checklist: unpin? I propose unpin api/router, keep runtime pinned +30m for post-deploy observation.
leo-release: Agreed. Unpin command: `/deploy unpin api router`
deploy-bot: Commands executed. runtime remains pinned until 03:15 UTC.
jen-console: I'll post consolidated release notes (including prefetch flag info and console proxy header) and link to PR.
leo-release: Thanks team. Postmortem exercise: run a quick rollback drill next week to validate the thermostat auto-hold and deploy-bot rapid-rollback path.
deploy-bot: Canary closed. All done. :white_check_mark:
